title: paronychia tetragona
intro: Paronychia tetragona, commonly known as Four Corners Spurge, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include being antifungal, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that aid in wound healing and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Paronychia tetragona include treating skin irritations, wounds, and infections, as well as having anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of Paronychia tetragona include triterpenoids and cardenolides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
